title: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture

result.label: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture
result.statement: Constructs ample rank-two bundles on P^1 P^1 with no smooth Hermitian metric of strictly Griffiths-positive curvature, disproving Griffiths' positivity conjecture already on the quadric surface.
